queries: Claude Code developer productivity randomized controlled study 2026 technical debt

sources_considered.why: Causal study of coding-agent adoption measuring both velocity and technical debt. It covers agents generally.
Secondary summary of an internal company experiment, not read or verified.

receipt.public_excerpt: quality risks are persistent across settings, with static-analysis warnings and cognitive complexity rising by roughly 18% and 39%, indicating sustained agent-induced technical debt even when velocity advantages fade.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows that coding agents in general raise speed at first and also add lasting technical debt. It does not isolate Claude Code or settle whether the speaker's condition holds.

unresolved_gaps: No rigorous study measuring net productivity of Claude Code specifically, after technical debt, was found by the evaluation date.
Whether the condition (technical debt not swallowing the gains) holds is unknown.
